:::{#def-noise}
#### Noise

Let $\paren{\Predvar, \Outvar}$ be the [covariate](#def-covariate) and the outcome of one observation from a [population](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-population).

The **noise** $\noise$ of the outcome $\Outvar$ at the covariate value $\Predvar = \predvar$
is the [deviation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-deviation-pop-mean)
of the outcome $\Outvar$ from the [mean function](#def-mean-function) value $\truemeanf{\predvar}$:

$$
\noise \eqdef \Outvar - \truemeanf{\predvar}.
$$ {#eq-noise}

:::
